title: Turkish Lentil Stew with Tempeh
description: A hearty and comforting Turkish-inspired stew made with lentils, tempeh, and spices. Perfect for a cold winter's day.

ingredients.name: Turkish spices (sumac, cumin, coriander)
ingredients.notes: Blend together or use store-bought mix

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add soaked lentils, spices, and salt. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 4 cups water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Stir in corbasi and tempeh. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.
